mentions.name: hydra
mentions.description: A Rust command-line tool that finds and removes duplicate files, built to speed up cleaning out repeated downloads instead of manually deleting duplicates from the downloads folder.
mentions.problem: Downloading the same file multiple times leaves duplicates in the downloads folder that have to be removed manually.
mentions.audience: The author sometimes downloads the same file multiple times at work and has to go through the downloads folder and manually remove the duplicates.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a CLI tool in rust to find and remove duplicate files.

evidence.value: I built a CLI tool in rust to find and remove duplicate files.
